g.text: Complete pooled ROC / PR curves · display representatives
Exact threshold groups from every stored shared-cohort entry; no curve resampling. ROC requires both outcome classes.
0 representatives have missing/undefined curve support; details are in the plot manifest. AP in summary.csv uses its own step-integral definition.
